summary: Medallion Financial Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a $75M private placement of 8.25% Senior Notes due 2031. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, not a return of capital specified. The notes are unsecured, rank pari passu, bear semiannual interest, and mature May 1, 2031. No unusual premium, price per share, or defensive tactics mentioned. Expected use of proceeds could fund shareholder returns, but filing does not state dividends or buybacks. Watch for future disclosures on capital allocation; risk-arb not applicable.
